thread:
Maya: Heads up 1 EdgeWave requested a single 'evidence digest' for their marketplace listing (SOC2 summary, pen test pointer, firmware attestation, artifact-owner CSV). Can we agree on a machine-friendly format? :wave:
Raj: Yes. Security wants the redacted SOC2 PDF, a 1-paragraph SOC summary for partners, and pen test findings with CVE IDs mapped. Need a documented redaction checklist and TTL for presigned links.
Leo: For firmware attestation we can include signing key metadata, signing algorithm, and an audit trail reference. Partners prefer CSV; ops prefers JSON. Let's standardize on CSV with a notes column for freeform metadata.
Nina: SI integrators usually accept CSV or XLSX. Proposed CSV columns: artifact_type, filename, sensitivity_level, redacted, owner, contact, storage_path, presign_url, expires_at, proof_of_origin, notes.
Maya: Draft CSV example (single-line entries shown):
artifact_type,filename,sensitivity_level,redacted,owner,contact,storage_path,presign_url,expires_at,proof_of_origin,notes
SOC2,redacted_soc2_2025.pdf,confidential,true,security,sec@redwood.ai,s3://partners/edgewave/soc2,https://presign.example/abc,2025-12-31,s3://vault/versions/abc123,"redacted to remove customer IDs"
PEN,edgewave_pen_2025.pdf,internal,false,security,sec@redwood.ai,s3://partners/edgewave/pen,https://presign.example/def,2026-01-15,s3://vault/versions/def456,"full findings; sensitive CVEs marked for NDA"
FIRM,firmware_attest_v1.txt,confidential,true,infra,eng@redwood.ai,s3://partners/edgewave/firmware,https://presign.example/ghi,2026-06-30,kms-thumbprint:ab12cd,"contains signing key id and attestation statement"
Sofia: Legal will need to sign off on the attestation wording and on sharing presigned URLs. If pen test content includes undisclosed CVEs we must attach an NDA consent link or mark sensitivity as confidential.
Raj: I will prepare the SOC summary paragraph now: SOC2 Type II covering storage and change-control (period 2024-07 to 2025-07). Shared file is redacted to remove customer identifiers; full report available under NDA (contact sec@redwood.ai).
DevOpsBot: Presign job scheduled (job_id=ps-9921). ETA initial presigns 2025-11-18T10:00Z.
Nina: Can we add a short 'consent_url' column that points to a legal attestation doc or NDA template if needed? That will help partner SI flows.
Maya: Yes add consent_url and also include a 'retention_policy' column (e.g., partners-bucket:30d, vault:2y).
Leo: I'll build a tiny automation: script reads manifest.csv, calls presign API, and appends presign_url + expires_at. Example: python infra/publish_evidence.py --manifest manifest.csv --bucket partners/edgewave --ttl 30d. Outputs enriched CSV for partner upload.
Sofia: I'll review attestation text by EOD and post a signed link. Nina, please schedule a short sync with EdgeWave to confirm format and retention (15-20 min).
Nina: Scheduling now for Tue 2025-11-19 15:00 PT. Invites to EdgeWave integration lead, our security owner (Raj), infra (Leo), and legal (Sofia).
AuditorBot: Reminder: originals must be retained in secure vault for 2 years per compliance schedule.
Maya: Acknowledged. We'll keep originals in secure-vault and publish redacted copies to partners bucket.
Raj: Add a 'proof_of_origin' field (we will include s3 version ids or KMS key thumbprints) and an artifacts-checklist document stored in the vault.
Maya: Added. Action owners: Raj (redactions + SOC summary + proof_of_origin), Leo (firmware meta + script), Sofia (legal attestation + consent URL), Nina (partner call), Maya (assemble CSV, trigger presigns). I'll follow up after the sync and attach final CSV. :thumbsup:
